rows.en: A friendly unit requests rescue. Support them at once.
A friendly unit requests rescue. Go support them, now!
Would you wipe out the enemy and open a path for the friendlies?
Wipe out the enemy and open a path for the friendlies.
The enemy has broken through our defense line, I fear. Intercept them at once!
rows.notes: Transcript joins the sentences with 'desu ga'; read as two sentences.

rows.en: The enemy broke through the defense line! Intercept them, quick!
Enemy reinforcements, it would seem.
Enemy reinforcements.
Enemies incoming!
rows.notes: TF re-recording; the MUF clip was a different joke line.

rows.en: Enemy reinforcements, I see.
rows.notes: Whisper flagged nospeech, but the transcript fits the line; kept.

rows.en: Enemy reinforcements incoming!
Enemy reinforcements confirmed!
rows.notes: TF re-recording; the MUF clip said 'hey, an enemy'.

rows.en: Approaching enemies detected.
Enemies approaching. Be careful.
Enemy confirmed.
Enemy confirmed.
New enemy confirmed.
New enemy confirmed.
Enemy signal acquired.
Enemy signal caught!
The enemy reinforcements keep coming, it seems.
The reinforcements keep coming!
Enemy signal confirmed. We cannot let our guard down.
More enemy signals. Stay sharp.
The enemy reinforcements just keep coming.
rows.notes: TF re-recording; close to the MUF line.

rows.en: Enemy signals confirmed once again.
More enemies appearing!
Numerous enemy signals confirmed.
Many enemy signals confirmed.
How long are these enemy reinforcements gonna keep coming?!
Multiple enemies closing in fast.
Multiple enemies closing in fast!
There seem to be a great many enemies. Will you be all right?
There are a lot of enemies. Be careful.
I do worry whether this operation will truly go well.
Are you really up to this, I wonder?
It seems I cannot expect very much.
Just don't go acting on your own. Understood?
Would you at least refrain from getting in the operation's way?
You'd better succeed at an operation this simple.
We cannot afford to fail in this operation.
Operation start. Good luck.
rows.notes: kentou 'consideration' kanji for kentou 'fight well' (good luck).

rows.en: You will follow my instructions.
Stay sharp. The operation's starting.
Operation start. Are you quite ready?
We can't afford to fail this operation.
With you, I expect there will be no problem.
You'll be fine. I'm counting on you.
Would you leave the support to me?
I'm counting on you again. Good luck.
I would be grateful if you lived up to my expectations...
rows.notes: Ends on a trailing 'ga'; kept as trailing.

rows.en: I'm leaving this operation to you.
I pray for your fortune in battle.
rows.notes: gomuun 'no luck' kanji for gobuun 'fortune in battle'.

rows.en: Don't be reckless. Come back safely.
The success of this operation rests on you.
With your skill, an operation like this should be easy.
Failure is hardly possible, but...
rows.notes: Ends on a trailing 'ga'; kept as trailing.

rows.en: I believe in you. I know you'll pull it off.
I did not think you would make it back in one piece.
I'm amazed you actually made it back.
Well, well. That you succeeded could fairly be called a miracle.
I was a fool to expect anything from you.
Is this what they mean when they say luck is part of skill?
rows.notes: un wo heard for un mo (the saying 'un mo jitsuryoku no uchi').

rows.en: Honestly, we really are short of people these days.
rows.notes: A jab at the player: low-rating result line.

rows.en: Well, I suppose this is about what one would expect.
Operation successful. Return to base.
Your skill is not bad at all.
You did well. Good work.
rows.notes: Whisper flagged nospeech, but the transcript fits the line; kept.

rows.en: I would like you to keep this up next time as well.
Not bad at all. I'm expecting a lot next time too.
Resting up for the next operation is also part of your duty.
Keep this up next time too.
Impressive, as expected. There is nothing more to say.
Better results than I imagined. Impressive.
Splendid results!
Of course you succeeded. It's you, after all.
Is this what they call the power of Culture?
rows.notes: bunka = Culture, capitalised as Zentradi speech (glossary).

rows.en: I made some pineapple cake. Would you have some?
rows.notes: pain keeki: pineapple cake; not in the glossary as a Frontier food name.

rows.en: You seem tired. Then allow me to sing you a song.
Making me worry about you... You idiot.
